title: Bootstrap a runnable app shell
user_visible_behavior: The repository has a runnable app with a home route, one install command, one verification command, and one start command, all documented in init.sh.
verification: Run the documented install command from a clean checkout.
Run the documented verification command and confirm it passes.
Start the app and load the home route on a phone-sized viewport.
Replace the provisional commands in init.sh with the real install, verify, and start commands.
evidence: `npm run verify` passed: expo lint, `tsc --noEmit`, and `expo-doctor` 20/20 checks; rerun during independent validation.
`./init.sh` exited 0, ran `npm run verify`, and printed `npm start` without starting the dev server.
`npx expo export --platform android` bundled 1,306 modules successfully.
`CI=1 npx expo start --port 8081` returned Metro status `running`.
Physical Android render verified on Samsung Galaxy M13 (Android 14): Expo Go 58.0.5 displayed `Futsal Manager AI`, the Spanish subtitle, and `Aplicación en construcción` through a `uiautomator` dump.
Fast Refresh verified by changing the home status text on disk and observing the new text on the device; full reload verified by relaunching `exp://127.0.0.1:8081`.

Native debug build verified with `npm run android` (`expo run:android`): Gradle build succeeded, the 60 MB APK installed as `com.anonymous.futsalmanagerai`, and the Spanish home route rendered; Fast Refresh and a force-stop/full relaunch worked in the native app.
Independent validation verdict: accept, with no blocking findings.
notes: Expo SDK 58.0.19, Expo Router, TypeScript. ESLint is pinned to 9 because eslint-config-expo's plugins are incompatible with ESLint 10. `npm run verify` is the standard gate; `npm start` is never run by init.sh. Device loop: docs/device-development-workflow.md. Local debug application ID is the template placeholder `com.anonymous.futsalmanagerai` until a production ID is chosen. Spec: docs/specs/bootstrap-app-shell.md.

title: Implement design tokens and base UI primitives
user_visible_behavior: Buttons, cards, chips, inputs, and typography render with the DESIGN.md tokens on a mobile viewport.
verification: Render a small style gallery route or story page.
Compare primary, AI, card, chip, and input states against DESIGN.md tokens.
Confirm no colors or fonts outside DESIGN.md are introduced.
evidence: Spec created at `docs/specs/design-system-tokens.md`.
Installed Expo-compatible `@expo-google-fonts/space-grotesk`, `@expo-google-fonts/hanken-grotesk`, and `@expo-google-fonts/jetbrains-mono`; fonts load in `src/app/_layout.tsx` behind the splash gate.
Implemented `src/theme` tokens and `src/components/ui` primitives (`AppText`, `AppButton`, `Card`, `Chip`, `AppInput`); the home route and `/design-system` gallery consume them.
`npm run verify` passed after implementation: expo lint, `tsc --noEmit`, and `expo-doctor` 20/20 checks.
`./init.sh` exited 0, ran `npm run verify`, and printed `npm start` without starting the dev server.
`rg '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}' src/app src/components` returned no matches, so screens and primitives contain no literal colors.

Physical Android verification on Samsung Galaxy M13 (Android 14, Expo Go 58.0.5): home rendered with Space Grotesk, Hanken Grotesk, and JetBrains Mono; `Ver sistema de diseño` navigated to `/design-system`.

Gallery verified section by section via screenshots and `uiautomator` dumps: palette hex values, full typography scale, spacing scale, radii, primary/AI/secondary/disabled buttons, cards, four chips, and input default/error states.
Focused input was exercised on device: the primary ring appeared and `Infantil` was typed into the field; the error field kept its red border and message.
Fast Refresh verified by editing the gallery heading on disk and observing `Sistema de diseño · FR` on the device without a reload; the change was reverted and observed again.

Full reload verified by force-stopping Expo Go and reopening `exp://127.0.0.1:8081/--/design-system`; fonts rendered correctly and `adb logcat` showed no React Native errors, warnings, or font failures.
`npx expo export --platform android` bundled 1,269 modules successfully.
Added `eslint-import-resolver-typescript@3.10.1` as a devDependency so ESLint can resolve the `@/` path alias under the Expo flat config.
notes: Source of truth: DESIGN.md and docs/design/prototype/futsal_tactical_edge/DESIGN.md. Root DESIGN.md tokens win on conflicts. Custom font families load through expo-font; weights are selected by explicit family key because fontWeight is unreliable for custom fonts on Android. Spec: docs/specs/design-system-tokens.md.

title: Add mobile navigation shell
user_visible_behavior: A coach can move between Explorar, Pizarra, Asistente IA, and a locked Mi Club entry using Spanish labels and a bottom navigation bar.
verification: Open the app on a phone viewport.
Tap each navigation item and confirm the correct section opens.
Confirm Mi Club shows a locked next-phase state, not a broken route.
notes: Matches the prototype bottom navigation; Mi Club is a next-phase entry point and must not be implemented in the MVP.

title: Define and validate the Board Data schema
user_visible_behavior: An exercise's Board Data (tokens, cones, arrows, labels, ordered phases) validates against a versioned schema, and invalid data is rejected.
verification: Validate a valid multi-phase Board Data fixture and confirm it passes.
Validate fixtures with a missing phase coordinate and an unknown token type; confirm both fail with a clear error.
Record the schema version in the repository.
notes: Rendered with react-native-svg using full keyframe positions per phase, interpolated between phases. The board must preserve a 2:1 pitch ratio.

title: Add exercise, category, and programming data model
user_visible_behavior: The app can read exercises mapped to RFEF categories and one programming record per category from a single content source.
verification: Load the seeded data through the app's read layer.
Confirm an exercise mapped to two categories appears under both without duplication.
Confirm all seven RFEF categories exist as reference data.
notes: Categories are RFEF age brackets, never skill tiers (CONTEXT.md).

title: Record provenance and licensing for seed content
user_visible_behavior: Every exercise and programming record carries a source and license/attribution field, and content without a permitted status cannot be published.
verification: Inspect seeded records and confirm each has source and license/attribution metadata.
Attempt to publish a record marked unlicensed and confirm it is blocked.
Run the content validation check and confirm it fails on missing provenance.
notes: Licensing is a blocking risk. Reference inputs: adrimartinofutsal.es.tl, futsalcoach.es, keepmove.net, ejerciciosdefutbolsala.com, and the CMD Mora presentation.

title: Seed Infantil U14 exercises and programming
user_visible_behavior: An anonymous coach can browse a complete Infantil U14 set: programming plus a library of exercises, each with valid Board Data.
verification: Run Board Data validation over every Infantil U14 exercise and confirm all pass.
Confirm the Infantil U14 programming record renders all required sections.
Confirm every seeded exercise carries provenance and license metadata.
notes: First full category; the prototype and build brief both use Infantil U14.

title: Seed representative exercises for remaining categories
user_visible_behavior: Each remaining RFEF category has at least a minimum exercise set and a programming record, so filters never lead to empty screens.
verification: Open each of the seven categories and confirm at least one exercise and one programming record exist.
Run Board Data validation over all new exercises.
Confirm category mapping uses RFEF brackets, with no Chupetín-style stage leaked into filters.
notes: Minimum scope: three exercises plus one programming record per remaining category. Content is original or CMD Mora used with club permission; external reference sites are inspiration only.

title: Filter exercises and programming by category
user_visible_behavior: Selecting an RFEF category filters the exercise library and programming to that category, and the selection persists while navigating.
verification: Select Infantil U14 and confirm only its exercises and programming appear.
Select Senior and confirm the content swaps.
Confirm an exercise tagged to two categories appears under both.
notes: Anonymous, no registration required.

title: Build the general explore screen
user_visible_behavior: A coach sees the category filter, weekly exercises, the methodology overview, and an entry point to the AI session generator, matching the prototype.
verification: Open Explorar on a phone viewport and compare layout with docs/design/prototype/01-explore-general.
Select a category and confirm the weekly exercises update.
Confirm the AI session entry point is visible and reachable one-handed.
notes: Reference: docs/design/prototype/01-explore-general/code.html.

title: Build the explore-by-category screen
user_visible_behavior: A coach sees the selected category's methodology focus, key concepts, and its filtered exercise library with an open-on-board action.
verification: Open a category and confirm methodology focus and key concepts render.
Confirm the library lists only that category's exercises.
Confirm the open-on-board action targets the selected exercise.
notes: Reference: docs/design/prototype/02-explore-by-category/code.html.

title: Build the exercise detail screen
user_visible_behavior: A coach sees an exercise's objective, category, duration, players, space, intensity, coaching cues, and ordered phase explanations.
verification: Open a seeded exercise and confirm every metadata field is shown.
Confirm coaching cues and phase explanations render in order.
Confirm a missing optional field does not break the screen.
notes: Reference: docs/design/prototype/03-exercise-detail-board/code.html.

title: Render Board Data on a 2:1 tactics board
user_visible_behavior: The board draws the pitch, player and keeper tokens, cones, and arrows from Board Data while preserving a 2:1 aspect ratio on any viewport.
verification: Render a seeded exercise and confirm tokens, cones, and arrows match the source data.
Resize from phone to tablet and confirm the pitch stays 2:1.
Render a half-court exercise and confirm it degrades gracefully.
notes: The board is a renderer and must not invent content. Player tokens are circular with mono shirt numbers.

title: Play board phases step by step
user_visible_behavior: A coach can step through and replay ordered phases, with each phase showing its positions, arrows, and explanation.
verification: Open a three-phase exercise and step Fase 1, Fase 2, Fase 3, confirming positions and order.
Use replay and confirm it restarts at phase one.
Confirm the reduced-motion preference disables non-essential animation.
notes: Phase playback is UI state, not persisted content.

title: Add golden tests for board playback
user_visible_behavior: Automated tests fail when phase positions or their order change unexpectedly.
verification: Run the golden test suite and confirm it passes on the current board.
Change one phase coordinate deliberately and confirm the suite fails.
Revert the change and confirm the suite passes again.
notes: Required by AGENTS.md verification rules.

title: Add a server-side LLM gateway
user_visible_behavior: AI features call one server-side gateway that holds the API key and logs category, feature, latency, and token/cost estimate.
verification: Call the gateway from the app and confirm a response is returned.
Confirm the API key is not present in any client bundle or network payload.
Confirm a gateway log entry records feature, latency, and cost estimate.
notes: Use DevExpert Inference (OpenAI-compatible, DEVEXPERT_BASE_URL and DEVEXPERT_API_KEY, model chat). Never expose API keys client-side.

title: Ground AI on seeded exercises and programming
user_visible_behavior: Given a category and query, the system retrieves relevant seeded exercises and programming to include in the AI context.
verification: Query for an Infantil U14 defensive exercise and confirm the retrieved context contains matching seeded exercises.
Confirm an archived exercise is excluded from retrieval.
Confirm a category with no exercises returns an explicit empty context, not invented content.
notes: Retrieval approach (embeddings vs keyword) is an implementation-time decision.

title: Generate a grounded session from constraints
user_visible_behavior: The API returns an objective and an ordered set of seeded exercises for a category and constraints such as player count, space, and focus.
verification: Request an Infantil U14 session for 9 players and confirm the response references seeded exercises.
Confirm every returned exercise id exists and is published.
Confirm an impossible constraint returns a clear refusal instead of fabricated exercises.
notes: Must be traceable to the library (build-brief success criteria).

title: Add the AI session generator to explore
user_visible_behavior: A coach enters a category and constraints, sees a generated session, and can open a proposed exercise on the board.
verification: Generate a session from the explore screen on a phone viewport.
Confirm each proposed exercise can open on the board.
Confirm loading, error, and quota states are handled.
notes: Entry point visible on the general explore screen.

title: Adapt an exercise to player count and space
user_visible_behavior: The API returns a variant of a source exercise adjusted to a constraint, with valid Board Data and a visible link to the source exercise.
verification: Request a 7-player variant of a seeded exercise and confirm the Board Data validates.
Confirm the response cites the source exercise.
Confirm an invalid constraint is rejected clearly.
notes: Variants are ephemeral in the MVP.

title: Add the AI variant adapter to exercise detail
user_visible_behavior: A coach can request a variant from an exercise page and open the adapted exercise on the board.
verification: Request a variant from a seeded exercise on a phone viewport.
Confirm the adapted exercise renders on the board.
Confirm the source exercise remains reachable.
notes: Reference: docs/design/prototype/03-exercise-detail-board/code.html.

title: Answer coaching questions with grounded chat
user_visible_behavior: The API answers a coaching question using retrieved seeded content and returns the exercises it used.
verification: Ask a category-specific coaching question and confirm the answer cites seeded exercises.
Ask for an exercise that does not exist in the library and confirm the API refuses to fabricate it.
Confirm the response includes source exercise ids.

title: Build the AI tactical assistant screen
user_visible_behavior: A coach can chat with the assistant, see grounded answers with exercise previews, use suggested follow-ups, and open a proposal on the board.
verification: Send a question on a phone viewport and confirm the answer and exercise preview render.
Tap a suggested follow-up and confirm it sends a new message.
Open a proposed exercise on the board from the chat.

title: Enforce a daily anonymous AI quota
user_visible_behavior: Anonymous users get a fixed number of AI requests per day, enforced server-side; browsing and the board keep working when the quota is reached.
verification: Exhaust the quota and confirm further AI requests are blocked with a clear message.
Confirm browsing and board playback still work after the quota is reached.
Simulate a new day and confirm the quota resets.
notes: 5 requests per day, keyed by Expo installation ID plus hashed IP, enforced server-side. Consider shared club networks and the timezone used for the daily reset.

title: Add adversarial AI grounding tests
user_visible_behavior: Automated tests fail if any AI feature invents library content or ignores the selected category.
verification: Run the grounding suite and confirm it passes.
Add an adversarial prompt that asks for a non-existent exercise and confirm it is rejected.
Confirm every AI output under test references only published exercise ids.
notes: Required by AGENTS.md verification rules.

title: Load content and board offline from bundled JSON
user_visible_behavior: The exercise library, programming, and board playback work with no connectivity from a bundled content package.
verification: Enable airplane mode and open the exercise library.
Open a seeded exercise and play its phases offline.
Confirm a missing or invalid bundled package fails the build rather than shipping.
notes: Content is versioned JSON validated at build time and shipped with the app bundle.

title: Save generated AI results on device
user_visible_behavior: A coach can reopen a generated session or variant after restarting the app, including without connectivity.
verification: Generate a session and a variant, close the app, reopen offline, and confirm both are still available.
Confirm saved results use a versioned local record format.
Confirm the coach can clear saved results.
notes: Store on device only; no account or cloud sync in the MVP.

title: Verify the MVP on a real phone and tablet
user_visible_behavior: The end-to-end anonymous flow works and is legible on a real phone and tablet at pitch distance.
verification: Complete filter, exercise, board, AI session, and board again on a real phone.
Repeat on a tablet and confirm pitch-distance legibility.
Record device models and any issues in PROGRESS.md.
notes: Manual validation; cannot be replaced by desktop emulation. Record evidence in PROGRESS.md.
